query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM rooms
                WHERE id = $1
                  AND deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND closed_at IS NULL
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM room_bans rb
                      WHERE rb.room_id = rooms.id
                        AND rb.revoked_at IS NULL
                        AND (rb.ends_at IS NULL OR rb.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                  )
            ) as "exists!"
